definitions.explanation: The first and smallest planet in the Solar System, closest to the Sun. Named after the element water (水) in the Chinese five-element system.

examples.japanese: {水星|すいせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦{惑星|わくせい}→惑星：05052_wakusei⟧だ。
examples.english: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

examples.japanese: {水星|すいせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肉眼|にくがん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}え→見える：01165_mieru⟧にくい。
examples.english: Mercury is hard to see with the naked eye.

examples.japanese: {水星|すいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表面温度|ひょうめんおんど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The surface temperature of Mercury varies greatly between day and night.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{彗星|すいせい}→彗星：05053_suisei⟧ (comet). Both are read すいせい but written with different kanji and have completely different meanings.

NAMING:
Part of the Chinese five-element planet naming system. Wednesday (⟦{水曜日|すいようび}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧) is associated with Mercury, paralleling Western tradition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水星|すいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧ (Mercury's orbit)
- {水星|すいせい}⟦{探査|たんさ}→探査：05325_tansa⟧ (Mercury exploration)
- {水星|すいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公転周期|こうてんしゅうき} (Mercury's orbital period)
